method: One common calibrated reference for these two independent source originals: transfer mean middle-face width from fixed original neutral scale; never fit individual pose full-body height
formula: 537 * mean(new right head span, new left head span) / 331.5

input_measurements.head_proxy_measurement: maximum horizontal span in face middle band, excluding ears and shoulders
maximum horizontal span in face middle band, excluding ears and shoulders

projection_limit: 3/4 head width is a scale proxy, not a guarantee of identical projected full-body height. Both directions are visually checked against stand/air context.
